milestones.name: D810 SDK and WPD readiness
milestones.completion_contract: Version 2.5 requirements, native Phase 0 harness, SDK acceptance workflow, approved single-slot spool, fake-only legacy capture commands, operator-session-wide camera lease, transaction watchdog, Live View handoff, and redacted evidence contracts are ready.

milestones.name: Single D810 non-destructive verification
milestones.completion_contract: One D810 passes redacted SDK/WPD inventory, power-cycle/PnP identity continuity, principal setting readback, and a native command-trace contract without photographic-setting writes or capture.

milestones.name: Single D810 physical capture and Live View Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: After an explicit operator resume and empty spool proof, one D810 passes one-shot then 10 of 10 SDK-capture/WPD-recovery transactions with verified canonical PC originals and exact-object cleanup, recovery tests, and selected-camera Live View handoff tests.

milestones.name: Dual D810 sequential hybrid Phase 0
milestones.completion_contract: Two D810 bodies pass cross-transport identity binding, 10 hybrid pairs, 100 of 100 stability, fault tests, and final transport approval.

milestones.name: Offline pre-gate foundations
milestones.completion_contract: Parameterized optical math, synthetic fixture contracts, versioned rig-profile schema, three-state setup assessment, and synthetic measurement-to-bounded-correction contracts pass without claiming an approved rig or A0 quality result.

milestones.name: D810 offline planar stitching PoC
milestones.completion_contract: Approved D810 optical fixture and rig profile meet setup, bounded automatic correction, geometry, color, seam, crop, memory, and timing criteria.

milestones.name: Simulated integration foundations
milestones.completion_contract: Versioned application/IPC contracts and fake dual-camera workflows pass while remaining visibly simulated and unconnected to real hardware.

milestones.name: Integrated sequential MVP
milestones.completion_contract: One operation captures CAM-A then CAM-B, preserves, stitches, and reports with safe failure handling.

milestones.name: Acceptance and packaging
milestones.completion_contract: Acceptance, durability, redistribution, installer, and release gates are approved.

work_items.title: Rebaseline canonical requirements to D810 SDK-capture and WPD-recovery sequential transactions
work_items.verification: requirements, source index, plan, ADR, and test contracts consistently reference WPD baseline, exclusive SDK capture, WPD recovery, and canonical PC originals

work_items.title: Verify Windows native Phase 0 toolchain
work_items.verification: MSVC x64 and CMake versions are recorded; .NET is not a Phase 0 dependency

work_items.title: Obtain and isolate the official D810 Camera Remote SDK
work_items.verification: requester accepts the displayed license and the SDK is stored only under ignored local tooling

work_items.title: Implement Phase 0 CLI transaction and evidence harness with fake transport
work_items.verification: CMake build and CTest cover success, partial failure, ambiguity, persistence, redaction, and no retry

work_items.title: Define selected-camera SDK Live View and hybrid capture handoff contract
work_items.verification: Contract and fake tests prove one selected Live View, preview exclusion, WPD baseline close, SDK capture close, WPD recovery, and resume only after canonical PC persistence

work_items.title: Close legacy hardware entry points and add operator-session-wide Phase 0 exclusivity
work_items.verification: legacy direct capture commands accept fake transport only; every real SDK/WPD CLI command holds one named OS mutex shared by the same interactive Windows logon session; pair and hybrid transactions share a 180-second total watchdog; focused negative and contention contracts pass

work_items.title: Implement Nikon SDK D810 adapter and redacted one-camera status inventory
work_items.verification: the assigned D810 is listed as CAM-A and basic SDK status is persisted without committed real identity, photographic-setting change, capture, or an unclosed session

work_items.title: Complete principal setting readback and native SDK command-trace contracts
work_items.verification: JPEG, size, exposure, ISO, WB, and focus capabilities return a value or explicit unavailable state; a traceable MAID boundary proves no photographic-setting CapSet, capture, Live View start, WPD call, or delete, while required control-plane calls remain distinguishable

work_items.title: Persist stable local CAM-A identity
work_items.verification: a recorded power cycle and subsequent PnP re-enumeration restore CAM-A using only local identity state; physical cable and port-change coverage remains in M1B

work_items.title: Prove one-shot then 10 single D810 hybrid captures and exact spool cleanup
work_items.verification: Under the resolved HG-0008 scope, start with a dedicated empty card, confirm the WPD spool contains zero camera payload objects of any type, capture exactly once through SDK under exclusive control, close SDK, recover exactly one JPEG through WPD, validate and hash the canonical PC original through atomic rename and reread, delete only that attributed object without recursion, and verify the spool again contains zero payload objects before another transaction; first prove one-shot, then 10 of 10

work_items.title: Run one-camera disconnect and software restart hybrid recovery tests
work_items.verification: USB-disconnect and software-process recovery close FailedPartial without retry; physical power-cycle/reboot and power-off recovery are N/A by the 2026-08-09 operator decision; cleanup is attempted only after canonical PC persistence

work_items.title: Prove selected-camera SDK Live View and hybrid capture handoff
work_items.verification: Ten handoffs stop and close Live View, take and close a WPD baseline, capture and close SDK, recover and persist through WPD, then resume selected-camera Live View; timeout or hang is retained as FailedPartial

work_items.title: Bind both D810 bodies across SDK and WPD and verify stable CAM-A/B identity
work_items.verification: one-body-at-a-time registration proves SDK/WPD same-body binding before dual handoff; three connection-order changes and both port swaps preserve CAM-A/B

work_items.title: Prove 10 exclusive CAM-A to CAM-B transactions
work_items.verification: 10 of 10 pairs complete with no overlap, retry, mispair, loss, or ambiguous adoption

work_items.title: Run 100 of 100 paired stability test
work_items.verification: machine-readable report proves 100 paired first-attempt successes and timing distributions

work_items.title: Run two-camera fault matrix
work_items.verification: USB disconnect, restart-after-A software-process interruption, order, and port tests preserve evidence and recover on a new transaction; physical power-cycle/reboot and power-off recovery are N/A by operator decision

work_items.title: Record SDK-capture and WPD-recovery transport decision evidence
work_items.verification: Approved one-shot hybrid decision and final GO-SDK-WPD-SEQUENTIAL or STOP are recorded in ADR

work_items.title: Implement parameterized D810 A0 DPI feasibility calculator
work_items.verification: independent tests cover A0 required pixels, D810 rotation/layout, overlap, crop, effective DPI, and shortfall without emitting a recommendation or approval

work_items.title: Define rights-cleared synthetic stitch fixture and quality-metric contracts

work_items.title: Define versioned rig-profile schema and validation
work_items.verification: JSON Schema validates shape/type and draft nulls; runtime contracts reject unsupported version, missing provenance, invalid validity ordering, assessment-time expiry, reversed correction envelopes, bad bounds, and absent-unapproved-value violations

work_items.title: Define setup-assist and bounded automatic-correction decision contract
work_items.verification: pure C++ contracts validate structured profile status/version/provenance/time trust and cover ready, ready-auto-correction, physical-adjustment-required, all hard blockers, invalid values, boundary equality, deterministic output, and input immutability without hardware or approved default thresholds

work_items.title: Connect synthetic image measurements to bounded setup correction decisions
work_items.verification: known synthetic shift, rotation, scale, exposure, and color differences produce deterministic measurements; only profile-bounded values become correction proposals and over-limit values are rejected without mutating the profile or claiming real A0 quality

work_items.title: Approve D810 A0 optical and quality contract
work_items.verification: 150, 180, and 200 DPI feasibility, rig values, chart, and thresholds are approved

work_items.title: Create rights-cleared D810 A0 fixture and quality oracle

work_items.title: Implement constrained D810 planar stitch pipeline

work_items.title: Add setup, correction, stitch quality, memory, and timing metrics
